title: Lint on the current Topic
notes: Pass when: L1 to L6 pass (the course check passes on the repo's Topics), and a test lesson whose Check tests an untaught Skill fails L1 (the course check, run in the fixture folder, fails and names L1). The fixture folder holds a course/ and docs/ laid out like the repo's. It can be written only once Topic files have Skills and the lesson lint exists (#237); until then the case is pending. No model is called.
